definition.m0: default allow mask; one observe pass; fast must stay all zero
definition.m1: all-true allow mask; one observe pass; fast must move
definition.m1_grad: all-true allow mask plus one backward; the 16 write heads must leave the no-gradient set
definition.m2: after a write-enabled step, score the next sentence from the same state intact vs with fast zeroed
definition.m3: scale world weights by 1.5 and compare output distributions with the unperturbed model
definition.closed_state: the nine legacy readings on the main subject stay equal before and after

criteria.m0: fast abs sum is 0 under the default mask
criteria.m1: fast abs sum is > 0 and its digest differs from M0
criteria.m1_grad: all 16 write_heads have a gradient; the nonzero count is reported
criteria.m2: the intact and ablated distributions differ and max |delta| > 1e-6
criteria.m3: the perturbed and unperturbed distributions are bit identical (max |delta| == 0)
criteria.closed_state: the nine legacy readings stay equal and the main parameter digest does not move
criteria.rerun: the R38 anchor carries a commit, a runner blob sha1, a runner sha256 and a core sha256
